title: pilot.input
description: client → server → host (relayed inside `relay`). Analogue state of a phone used as a virtual gamepad. Sent on change at up to 30 Hz, and at 5 Hz while unchanged as a keep-alive; if the host receives none for 500 ms it centres pitch, yaw and roll and holds throttle. The server may drop all but the newest queued input.

craft.description: Seat: VEHICLE for the pilot, BOOSTER for the booster pilot.

n.description: Input counter, increasing; the host ignores inputs older than the last applied.
